events.body:
## Context

There are 18 "merge request" occurrences (e.g. `README.md`, `docs/index.md`, `docs/developer-guide/contributing.md`), but git.owaspblt.org uses pull requests. `docs/getting-started/projects.md` lists every folder except `blt-cron`.

## What to do

1. Replace the wording outside the internal plan.
2. Add `| BLT Cron | [blt-cron](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/BLT-Cron) |` alphabetically.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `grep -rn "merge request" blt-docs --include=*.md` is empty outside the plan
- [ ] blt-cron listed
- [ ] Strict build passes

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-docs && mkdocs serve
```

---
